purpose: Verify that two exact post-states from one matched Qwen3 transition can be compared with one shared task-functional ruler before population calibration.

endpoint.name: heldout_correct_answer_nll_shift

dataset.prompt_template:
Solve the problem. Show concise reasoning and end with the numeric answer.

A box starts with {start} items, receives {added}, then gives away {removed}. How many remain?

endpoint.aggregation: equal-example mean of within-example completion-token mean NLL
endpoint.paired_direction: candidate minus reference; positive means candidate post-state assigns lower likelihood to the frozen correct completions

validity_gates: all input artifact SHA256 values match
both pre-state digests match the same frozen snapshot
saved updates exactly reconstruct both recorded post-parameter digests
post buffers equal their recorded digests
encoded prompt and completion bank identity is recorded
within-arm fresh reconstruction repeats are exact
nonclaims: one selected state does not estimate population average shift B
T1b is a task proxy for the declared arithmetic bank, not general model quality
the common eager evaluator is a shared ruler, not mathematical truth
a nonzero T1b effect is not a correctness error
this smoke is not operator attribution and does not identify a source operator
one-step task transition does not establish long-run training harm
